meta.title: Number of medium-sized factories in Mumbai

prompt: How many medium-sized factories are there in Mumbai?

clarifications.answer: Define it by blue-collar headcount: 50 to 200 workers, geometric mean ~100 workers per medium factory.
Take Mumbai's population as 2 crore, of which about half is working population.
Assume about 75% of the working population does blue-collar work (~75 lakh people).
Assume 10% of blue-collar workers are in factories, and 30% of those are in medium-sized factories.

common_traps: Counting the whole population or all workers instead of narrowing to blue-collar factory workers.
Forgetting to convert a worker count into a factory count via workers-per-factory.
Picking workers-per-factory arbitrarily instead of a geometric mean of the 50-200 range.

anchors.1: Guesses a factory count with no worker-based reasoning.
anchors.3: Estimates factory workers but does not convert to a factory count, or defines 'medium' loosely.
anchors.5: Chains population to blue-collar to factory to medium-factory workers, then divides by workers-per-factory.

anchors.1: No narrowing from population to the relevant worker pool.
anchors.3: Narrows workers but with shares not clearly reasoned.
anchors.5: Applies sensible successive shares (working, blue-collar, factory, medium-factory).

anchors.1: Lakh/crore conversions slip; lands far outside a plausible range.
anchors.3: Reaches a number with a slip, landing just outside 1500-3500.
anchors.5: Carries the successive-share and workers-per-factory math cleanly, landing near 2250.

anchors.3: Mentions a check but does not complete it.
anchors.5: Cross-checks that ~2250 medium factories fits Mumbai's scale as a major industrial hub.
